reviews.comment: POLS 308 is just a hard class, but Medina actually cares about whether the students are learning and will adjust lectures accordingly. The homework is challenging but you can work on it in groups. He is approachable and a good teacher who does not want to see anyone fail. Just devote time to the work and you should be fine!
Professor Medina was awesome in POLS 308, he explained the material well and was very responsive to emails.

Try to take this class with somebody else. The topic is complicated for people without a background in math or science, i.e. most POLS majors, and the lectures are rarely helpful. Attendance is mandatory, measured in the form of weekly emails sent asking questions about lectures, although the papers and tests aren't bad. Very inaccessible too

This class is very interesting, I couldn't recommend it enough. PARTICIPATION matters and he does keep track of it, its a big part of your grade. READ articles be assigns and he ready for class discussion. This is a great pols class 10/10, he's pretty passionate about what he teaches. Without a doubt one of my favorite teachers!

In addition to being one of the most poorly set-up classes I've ever taken (see December 29th review of Carlo Horz for more on this), Medina made it worse by being very inaccessible. He responded to emails insanely late, including emails asking for urgent help. I did fine due to some experience with the subject and I basically became our class' TA.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Medina was my TA. This class is tremendously hard. I wouldn't have passed without help from peers. He was inaccessible, and everything was asynchronous, which made the labs useless as hands on learning. Take this class in person if you can, and Medina could've been a much better TA. Make friends in this class, or ya may not pass.

Definitely the hardest class I've taken at TAMU. Medina is alright at teaching it, definitely one of the better options. His lectures are confusing, especially since they don't have much to do with the homework. He'll help you in office hours-that saved my grade. 6 homeworks, one midterm, and one project make up most of your grade
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader
